name: Basilique de la Visitation d'Annecy

note: Limestone neo-Romano-Byzantine basilica with a huge genuinely recessed arched tower-porch, stepped buttress shoulders, pierced octagonal belfry, patterned tapering spire and bronze cross; long tiled nave and polygonal apse. Sources disagree whether 72 m includes a separately described 7 m bronze cross. This model adopts the monastery history's explicit 72 m total rather than an unverified 79 m total; the 7 m cross assembly spans y=65–72 with its lower stem within the spire cap and exposed projection 3 m, estimated from photographs. Spire y=49–69 and nave ridge 26 m are estimated proportions. Outer ways 112145208 and 1557620926 are stitched at their shared endpoints from relation 21373069. Neighbouring monastery and steep terrain are excluded; y=0 is the rigid local entrance foundation plane, not a surveyed elevation. Cityscape: not tested. Full 3D world: not tested.
